subject: The score path on digit canvases: the stack of d_t(c) = eps(x_t, t, c) - eps(x_t, t, no digit) over sampler steps 0 to 15 for one canvas and one seed, from the frozen digit U-Net, as Loop 10's candidate third space beside captions and noisy canvases
kind: concept on an existing model; the score-path encoder is planned (step X4) and not designed
published: nothing: static PNG and SVG on markdown pages

code_checkout.note: read; CanvasUNet built on the CPU with untrained weights only to count weights and trace shapes

route: not written: this loop writes only inside 00-ladder, and the route file belongs under plans/

style.deep dives: clip-contrastive, drawn with figure_kit.py copied unchanged from the NoisyCLIP ladder
style.new_family: score-path, in score_path_family.py; registers itself into style_samples.FAMILIES on import, the skill's file is not edited

colour_concordance.palette: text is blue #1f5fd0 in the overview and lilac #b9a7e8 in the deep dives; canvas green, frozen grey and score-path rose match in both
orange is unused: this loop reads and does not push
rose cells are negative d values and green cells positive ones; green there marks sign, not the canvas encoder

overview.illustrative: noise draw on the canvas, shared-space dots, hollow test bars

0_5_network_view.illustrative: every size on the score-path encoder; sp4 cells hold no values; sp2 d_t tiles are empty

1_illustrations.why: this loop's rule: no Codex image renders, no GPU, no API tokens

2_miniature.design: 4 pixels, 2 toy steps x - eps_PoE, eps(x, c) = x + u_c + v_c * x with integer u and v, a 2 x 8 integer encoder, 2-number caption vectors, tau 0.07 from w4_train.py; a hand-set toy that predicts nothing

companion.why: not in this loop's hand-back list

open_for_x4: the digit models have 11 labels (0 to 9 and no digit), so a joint score path has no definition; the gap test needs one
which x_t the path reads: the product's own DDIM run, or a test canvas noised once per step
which window: ddim_timesteps(50)[:16] (t 999 to 693, W4's) or v2_learn's SDXL_MATCHED (t 712 to 480)
raw d_t or V2's scaled maps
product_eps returns only the sum under no_grad, so the separate d_t must be taken as v2_learn.maps does
